response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM grp) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.insurstat AS insurance_status, g.avg_remaining, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining / o.mean_avg_remaining AS ratio FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
